==== Film profiles for Film simulation, in data/filmsim.lut ====

Derived from spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato
https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm
Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0:
https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm/blob/main/SPEKTRAFILM_LICENSE.txt
Modified by the vkdt project (https://github.com/hanatos/vkdt), whose
mklut-profiles.py encodes the profiles as the lookup table vkdt_wasm ships.
